name: E01_baseline_hsv
decision_and_reason: Discarded. Fails on brown eggs and light-colored tables; median IoU is virtually 0 (0.0011).

name: E02_lab_otsu_a
decision_and_reason: Discarded. a-channel (green-red) has insufficient contrast between egg shell and neutral backgrounds; severe under-segmentation.

name: E03_lab_otsu_L
decision_and_reason: Kept as stepping stone. Lightness channel Otsu captures egg brightness effectively; median IoU improved significantly to 0.1631.

name: E04_lab_otsu_L_hull
description: LAB Otsu L-channel with Convex Hull
decision_and_reason: Kept as improvement. Convex hull fills internal specular glare holes on eggshell and boosts recall from 0.457 to 0.540.

name: E05_bg_contrast_hull
description: Border LAB Delta-E distance + Otsu + Convex Hull
decision_and_reason: Selected as Winner. Border-prior Delta-E color distance adapts to both white and brown eggs. Highest mean IoU (0.3494) and median IoU (0.2987).

name: FINAL
description: Best algorithm: Border Delta-E distance + Otsu + Convex Hull
decision_and_reason: Final evaluation on locked eval split. Achieved 0.2825 mean IoU and 0.4024 precision on unseen evaluation images.
